    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

public class Swap1 {
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
}

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }

Correction to fix LoopInvariantBeforeLoop error: The loop invariant must hold before the first iteration, i.e., at i == 0. For i == 0, the quantifications over j in [0, i) are over an empty range, so the universal quantifications are vacuously true. Therefore, the loop invariants as stated are correct and should not cause an error.

However, the error suggests the verifier cannot establish the invariant before the loop. To fix this, explicitly state that for i == 0, the universal quantifications are true (vacuously). This can be done by changing the loop invariant to use <= i instead of < i or by adding an explicit clause for i == 0.

public class IsPrefix {

            return false;

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

    }

public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@   (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) &&
        //@     (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@   (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && !(j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]))) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j])
        //@ );
        //@ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[0..n-1], i, wordStart;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

    //@           )

        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@   (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) &&

            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        }

            return false;

            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

      @ disjoint behaviors;
      @ complete behaviors;
      @*/
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = num1 / num2;
            break;

            break;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   (((long)vec[j] * (long)a) > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) &&

        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
}

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@              (long)vec[i] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE &&
    //@              Integer.MIN_VALUE <= (long)vec[i] * (long)a && (long)vec[i] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a)
    //@          ) &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < vec.length; 
    //@              \result[i] == Integer.MAX_VALUE || \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE || \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a))
    //@         );
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
        //@ maintaining ret.length == vec.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@     ((long)vec[j] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) &&
        //@     ((long)vec[j] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE) &&
        //@     (Integer.MIN_VALUE <= (long)vec[j] * (long)a && (long)vec[j] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases vec.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
